verdict.rationale: While GitLab offers CI/CD build-and-test capabilities and an AI agent governance framework (Allow/Ask/Deny policies, session monitoring, human-in-the-loop approvals), the evidence pack contains no mention of a dedicated sandbox/staging environment isolated from production data for AI agents or AI-native testing workflows. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment documentation, evidence of production-data isolation for agent test runs, and any hands-on confirmation that AI agent testing doesn't touch production data.
